picks.name: Dego
picks.source_note: Already in your library (as Dego & Kaidi). New label discovery -- 2000 Black, his own collective/imprint. First release on the label.
picks.bio: "Power" (October 23, 2026, 2000 Black, cat. 2061BLACK) is a three-track EP from 4Hero co-founder and 2000Black collective leader Dego, written and produced with Mr Mensah and featuring vocals from Shantéh Fuller, arriving four years after his "Love Was Not Your Goal" LP.
picks.why_listen: Mid-tempo house and boogie from a broken-beat pioneer with decades of pedigree -- a smooth, soulful driver for a groove-focused stretch of a set.

picks.name: Budino
picks.source_note: Altered Circuits already seeded. New artist discovery -- her first original release on the label, made for her own DJ sets.
picks.bio: "Signal EP" (October 26, 2026, Altered Circuits, cat. ALT027) is a four-track EP from Berlin-based Italian producer Valentina Bodini, aka Budino -- her first original release on the label, grown out of material made for her own DJ sets.
picks.why_listen: Italo-leaning electro/house built with a DJ's instincts -- a solid, functional pick for a club-focused stretch of a set.
